actor update from action-divergent candidates before relocation proof

training_stage.stage_objective: design bounded relocation replay for action-divergent candidates

M1175 selected rows have action-divergence and positive margin-gap signal
M1175 selected rows have zero direct success-drop rows, so relocation is required before proof conversion
blocked_shortcuts: do not run relocation replay in this milestone
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, and review artifacts

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1176 is a replay design milestone and adds no behavior evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1176 defines how later replay should test wrong-history sensitivity but does not execute it.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If bounded relocation fails to produce source-diverse success drops, classify scarcity rather than weakening proof thresholds.
allowed_claims: no self-identification, driver capability, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-level claim

hypothesis: A bounded relocation replay design can test whether M1175 action-divergent candidates produce source-diverse wrong-history boundary rows without rerunning broad mining or changing actor inputs.
success_criteria: success and failure criteria are explicit
no relocation replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change occurs
failure_criteria: design cannot use M1175 exported candidates
replay, mining, actor training, PPO, promotion, private holdout, conversion, or actor-input change starts

commands.name: write_bounded_relocation_design
commands.command: write docs/m1176-v4-public-base-action-divergent-bounded-relocation-design.md and pre-register the follow-up run

decision_rule: M1176 may only design a bounded relocation replay and pre-register the run. It cannot execute relocation replay, run mining, train actor weights, run PPO, promote, use private holdout, change actor inputs, or convert rows into a proof corpus.
